name: Nosfiretu
look: a tall gaunt red vampire bat with crossed arms, a golden horned mask with purple eyes and fangs, silver spikes on its head, a great purple cape of wings lined with gold, and a long segmented tail
entry: It wraps itself in its wings like a cape and stands perfectly still in the dark, until something warm passes by. Then it drinks the heat from its prey, leaving it shivering.
how: Evolve Operbat at level 36. It learns Bitter Blade when it evolves.
